Clarke as translator carries the same sentence. The second, unpunctuated recall (“‘When you want something…’ he had said”) is Santiago remembering, so the first instance is rightly Melchizedek’s. Translation date: US HarperSanFrancisco 1993 (UK editions print the translation copyright as 1992; wording identical for this line).
